name: Attack on the Tower
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Here's what your lookin' for: Trelane's phylactery, Trelane's orb, an' Trelane's ember agate.

All three should be in chests within the tower an' you shouldn't have a problem opening the chests on your own; you just have to be careful of the ogres.

The tower's defenses won't take care of 'em on their own; you'll need to have your weapons at the ready. Those ogres find out you're there and stealing from 'em, an' they'll be sure to put the hurt on you.

Be careful, an' good luck.
narrative.objectives: Find Trelane's Phylactery, Trelane's Orb, and Trelane's Ember Agate, and return them to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Malin couldn't've asked a worthier person to come here an' aid us, adventurer. You've done a grand job!

He'll be pleased to see what an overwhelming success our mission's been.
narrative.requestItemsText: You do this, an' I'm sure Malin'll be more than pleased with you.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 32 to 39, 18,500 XP in all.

quests.name: Malin's Request
quests.objectiveText: Find Skuerto at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.

quests.name: Worth Its Weight in Gold
quests.objectiveText: Find 10 Witherbark Tusks, 4 Witherbark Medicine Pouches and a Shadow Hunter Knife for Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Wand over Fist
quests.objectiveText: Find Trelane's Wand of Invocation and return it to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Trelane's Defenses
quests.objectiveText: Find an Azure Agate and bring it to Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Attack on the Tower
quests.objectiveText: Find Trelane's Phylactery, Trelane's Orb, and Trelane's Ember Agate, and return them to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.

quests.name: Malin's Request
quests.objectiveText: Take the Sealed Letter to Archmage Malin in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
